title: TimeRadar official reproduction
information_permissions: Official pretrained zero-shot; offline native scoring
code_entry: TimeRadar official runner; external to this package
conclusion: Eight public zero-shot benchmarks; original evaluation conditions preserved.

title: Early temporal/time-frequency prototype
information_permissions: Source-only 10k; PSM exploratory query
conclusion: Hybrid did not exceed TF, late fusion or history mean consistently.

title: Hybrid V1 Stage1
information_permissions: Public source FIT only; three training seeds in related runs
conclusion: 8000-update source SSL; training validity is not detection benefit.

title: V1 system ablations / Z
information_permissions: Source-trained fixed calibration; PSM development; modules not mechanism proofs
conclusion: Cross-off outperformed full on several metrics; no stable full-model synergy.

title: V1 event F and normal-adaptation/calibration controls
information_permissions: SMD independent support/query events; historical development exposure
conclusion: Event supervision evaluated with normal adaptation and calibration controls; not a general F success.

title: H5 source contamination
information_permissions: Public source replacement controls; fixed PSM query
conclusion: Source Stage1 contamination replacement is not target Stage2-U robustness.

title: Target mixed-U ABC
information_permissions: SMD historical entity; source/target calibration separated
conclusion: No clear anomaly-specific degradation beyond normal replacement; single donor/event constraints.

title: Frozen causal reference center
information_permissions: Matched source training and controlled mechanisms; old V1 frozen
conclusion: Stopped center candidate; no stage B; does not reject mixed-U research.

title: Signed Q/K Cross selection correction
information_permissions: Independent generated normal FIT/CAL and relation tests; no real-test tuning
conclusion: Training/route activity did not establish independent prediction or relation-detection benefit.

title: Published SOC learning-objective control
information_permissions: Matched generated runs; drift and augmentation negatives retained
conclusion: Not a complete CAROTS reproduction; proxy loss and gradient activity did not establish sustained detection.

title: Complete RoCA normality-learning comparison
information_permissions: SMAP/SMD target normal pools; not same training permission as source-only Hybrid
conclusion: Complete published chain adapted to public assets; no stable benefit over initialization/static FIT controls.

title: Official TimeRadar initialization transfer
information_permissions: Matched source plan and updates; PSM exploratory
conclusion: Legal initialization transfer did not establish net Hybrid detection benefit.

title: P32 fixed multi-origin evidence readout
information_permissions: Frozen weights; source CAL only; causal origin alignment required
conclusion: Stopped readout without tuning horizons, thresholds or aggregation weights.

title: Source anomaly-discriminative objective
information_permissions: Source synthetic anomalies only; no target query labels for training
conclusion: Synthetic supervision did not provide useful real-query improvement.

title: U-head2000 vs U-full2000
information_permissions: Identical source init/FIT draw plan; only parameter-update scope differs
conclusion: Increasing trainable scope did not improve fundamental detection reliably.

title: T-anchor cross-view upgrade
information_permissions: Matched PSM development training and evaluation
conclusion: Stopped complete interaction candidate; no continued local repairs.

title: First LEFT-inspired joint-cycle replacement
information_permissions: Source-trained candidate; native LEFT remains external target-trained reference
conclusion: Partial base replacement did not establish net benefit; distinct from later native-LEFT lineage.

title: Original V1 target Full-shot8000
information_permissions: Target FIT expanded; pretest scaler permission disclosed; fixed 8000 maximum updates
conclusion: More complete target training did not recover V1 anomaly discrimination.

title: Native-LEFT frequency-axis FRFT candidate
information_permissions: Same target-native learning/scoring; seed2025; no query-selected order
conclusion: Stopped frequency-axis FRFT; not equivalent to TimeRadar FTFRecon.

title: Native-LEFT history / Self / Cross
information_permissions: Native target training; N/L/LS/LC/LSC; max budget and actual selection differ
conclusion: Small ranking changes did not yield stable sustained or known-lag detection benefit.

title: LEFT + ARX accumulated relation residual
information_permissions: Strict-past ARX vs current-state LEFT reconstruction; permission distinction retained
conclusion: Stopped accumulated fusion; simple relation baseline remains necessary.

title: LEFT/ARX simple OR event complementarity
information_permissions: Validation-calibrated PSM; discovery is not sustained coverage or certified FPR
conclusion: Eleven extra one-to-one event matches in development; independent CAL not established.

title: FIT-context relation reliability gate
information_permissions: FIT-only skill construction; validation-calibrated development comparison
conclusion: Stopped conditional rule; no neighbor, weight, EMA or threshold search.

title: SMD cross-data LEFT / ARX / OR
information_permissions: New fixed SMD entity; isolated roles; not selected by detection performance
conclusion: Cross-data comparison did not justify continuing relation-fusion candidates.

title: LEFT target-U normality/contamination sensitivity
information_permissions: SMD matched normal/anomaly replacement; no robust module added
conclusion: Normal shift and calibration mismatch not equivalent to contamination damage.

title: SWaT multi-event ABC2000 mixed-U
information_permissions: 31 public channels; isolated donor/22 query events; 9 long; independent CAL
conclusion: Contamination changed ranking/coverage tradeoffs without stable specific harm across events.

title: FIT normal-reference decoder bottleneck
information_permissions: FIT-only fixed reference; matched decoder updates; not original memory learning
conclusion: SWaT ranking gains came with unacceptable false alarms; PSM did not confirm.

title: TEP frozen conditional Ridge confirmation
information_permissions: Fixed runs201–220; normal FIT/SELECT/CAL1–100; prior exposure disclosed
conclusion: Conditional regression has real event evidence; does not prove complex Hybrid mechanisms.

title: Shared native predictive-cycle learning
information_permissions: Matched TEP and new PSM roles; strict-past prediction vs observed-current native reconstruction
conclusion: Full vs self-only/simple fusion lacked stable independent conditional benefit.

title: Whole-channel blindspot training and masked inference
information_permissions: Matched 2000 updates; masked-zero/nativeoff controls; public synthetic controls separate
conclusion: SWaT ranking/sustained coverage increased but false alarms unacceptable; PSM and controls did not support.

title: Mask auxiliary training with native inference
information_permissions: Target normal source4000+matched2000; isolated FIT/SELECT/CAL; historic aggregate exposure; not blind
conclusion: New fixed SMD setting: AP improvement failed to reproduce across3 seeds; no variant search.
